GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight.  When laying in near the 200m, rider had to stop and straighten his mount.  Stewards questioned rider regarding approaching the home turn and in the straight, whether could have improved into the race earlier and whether he was able to maintain a position closer to the rail on straightening. R ex  700m he felt he was gradually making ground, however did not wish to place his mount under full pressure too early elected to wait until straightening to ride his mount out fully.  He added that the mare finishes its races off best when outside of runners.
